definitions.norms: componentwise maximum absolute position and 3x3 rotation difference, same as np.allclose(rtol=0)
definitions.active_command: nonzero mecanum command on the interval to the neighbouring pose sample; does not assert physical displacement
definitions.stationary_command_1s: zero own drive commands throughout the preceding 1s and the interval to the neighbour; arm motion may exist
definitions.coast_transition: zero interval command but a nonzero own drive command in preceding 1s
definitions.neighbour_label: label at frame j versus pose[4*j-1] and pose[4*j+1], valid boundaries only
definitions.neighbour_pose: pose[i] versus pose[i+1] over all 50ms intervals
